message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about PreLicenseTraining login:

## Main Student Login Portal

The primary login page for students is:
- **https://prelicensetraining.com/login**

To log in, you will need:
- Your **login name** (which may be your email address unless you specified otherwise)
- Your **password**

## Mentor/Recruiter Login Portals

If you are a mentor, recruiter, or company representative, there are separate login portals:
- **https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login**
- **https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login**

## Forgotten Login Credentials

If you've forgotten your login information:
- **Forgot Login Name:** https://prelicensetraining.com/user/forgotLogin
- **Forgot Password (Mentor accounts):** https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword

## About PreLicenseTraining.com

PreLicenseTraining.com provides online insurance pre-licensing and continuing education courses. Their platform includes:
- Streaming video instruction
- Online textbooks
- Practice examination questions with rationales
- A virtual practice testing center called "StudyHall"
- 24/7 access from any location

They have helped over 150,000 individuals obtain and maintain their insurance licenses.

If you're a new user, you may need to sign up and select your state to get started with a course.

Sources:
1. https://prelicensetraining.com/login
2. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
3. https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
4. https://insurance.prelicensetraining.com/page/test-drive
5. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
6. https://prelicensetraining.com/user/forgotLogin
7. https://preclass.affordableeducators.com/conditions/
